privacy_page.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy_page.subtitle: RADICAL TRANSPARENCY IN HOW WE HANDLE YOUR DATA.
privacy_page.intro: At NUWESOFT ENGINEERING we value your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our site or use our services.
privacy_page.s1_body: We collect information you provide directly through contact forms, including your name, email address, and project details. We also automatically collect browsing information such as IP addresses, browser type, pages visited, and time spent, through cookies and similar technologies.
privacy_page.s2_body: We use your information to respond to your inquiries, provide requested services, improve our website, send communications related to our services (with your consent), and comply with legal and regulatory obligations.
privacy_page.s3_body: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share data with trusted service providers who help us operate our site and business (such as hosting, analytics, and communication services), always under confidentiality agreements.
privacy_page.s4_body: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacy_page.s5_body: We use essential cookies for site operation and analytical cookies to understand how users interact with our content. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings.
privacy_page.s6_body: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, and port your personal data, as well as to limit or object to its processing. To exercise these rights, contact us through the means indicated.
privacy_page.s7_body: If you have questions about this privacy policy, you can contact us at privacy{'@'}nuwesoft.com or through our contact form.
